problems.symptom: Users could receive 'Не удалось загрузить сайт' before the real page rendered.
problems.root_cause: Production once served a browser bootstrap that reconstructed the real HTML client-side instead of serving the verified self-contained page directly.
problems.resolution: The production lane now builds and deploys direct self-contained HTML and release/live guards reject the old bootstrap markers.
problems.verification: Push CI #140 deployed exact release 967a8157f32834ce5ba748d4ad22b9627299a6ca; production smoke passed with build=self-contained.

problems.symptom: Merged source changes previously could not publish the exact verified commit because GitHub Actions lacked the Vercel credential.
problems.root_cause: VERCEL_TOKEN was absent from GitHub Actions and the Vercel project uses the explicit Actions/CLI lane rather than automatic Git-linked deployment.
problems.resolution: The bounded VERCEL_TOKEN was restored. The existing exact-SHA verify -> prebuilt verify -> production deploy -> public smoke lane remains the delivery authority.
problems.verification: Issue #26 is closed completed. Push CI #140 for 967a8157f32834ce5ba748d4ad22b9627299a6ca passed verify and deploy-production; Vercel deployment dpl_72rU2CYTGV1GnDxD1n61nZbqS5Ee is READY and aliased to the canonical domain; exact-release production smoke passed.

problems.symptom: If client JavaScript failed, the original shipped HTML could hide the practical hall directory and direct contacts.
problems.root_cause: Recruitment cards were originally rendered only on the client even though canonical instructor/venue data was available at build time.
problems.resolution: The CMS-backed static build prerenders all 11 instructors and 18 venue records before JavaScript enhancement.
problems.verification: Push CI #140 and its exact public smoke report staticDirectory instructors=11 and venues=18 on release 967a8157f32834ce5ba748d4ad22b9627299a6ca.

problems.mitigation: Keep identity-safe typography for every unresolved trainer and reject namesakes, generic group/event photos, search thumbnails, face matching, private-account bypass and synthetic trainer photography.
